title: Finite generators from a comparison of presentations
statement: Let X be a ringed space, U an open, F a module on U, and P a finite presentation of F. Let psi: O_U^r -> F and alpha: O_U^r -> O_U^(P.generators.I), beta in the reverse direction, with alpha followed by P.generators.pi equal to psi and beta followed by psi equal to P.generators.pi. Then kernel psi admits a finite family of global generating sections.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BP(1), proof displayed map and final assertion

proof.text: Define k1 from kernel(phi) to kernel(psi) by beta, k2 from the free rank-r module to kernel(psi) by identity minus alpha followed by beta, and l from kernel(psi) to kernel(phi) by alpha. The comparison equations give the kernel lifts. Cancel the monic kernel inclusion to prove l k1 + kernel.ι psi k2 = identity.

The coproduct map from kernel(phi) and the free rank-r module is split epi, with right inverse given by l and kernel.ι psi into the two summands. Apply Mathlib epi_of_epi_fac to the right-inverse equation.

Generate the first summand by the finite relations of P and the second by the free basis. The source-library GeneratingSections.sigma construction and GeneratingSections.ofEpi yield finite generating sections of kernel(psi), indexed by the finite dependent sum over ULift Bool.
